movelist.name: Power Trick
movelist.effect: The user’s Attack stat and Defense stat are switched for the remainder of the scene, or until the user is switched out or Fainted.

movelist.name: Acupressure
movelist.effect: Roll 1d6. On a result of 1, raise the target’s Attack 2 Combat Stages. On a result of 2, raise the target’s Defense 2 Combat Stages. On a result of 3, raise the target’s Special Attack 2 Combat Stages. On a result of 4, raise the target’s Special Defense 2 Combat Stages. On a result of 5, raise the target’s Speed 2 Combat Stages. On a result of 6, raise the target’s Accuracy by +2.

movelist.name: Psych Up
movelist.effect: The user’s Combat Stages are changed to match the target’s Combat Stages. Psych Up cannot miss.

movelist.name: High Jump Kick
movelist.effect: If High Jump Kick misses, the user loses Hit Points equal to 1/4th of their Max Hit Points. A failure to hit due to a Move with the Shield keyword does not count as a miss. This Move cannot be used if Gravity is in effect.

movelist.name: Mind Reader
movelist.effect: The target becomes Read to the user until the end of the user’s next turn. The user may end this effect when making an Attack on the user, causing that attack to automatically hit; OR when the Read target uses an Attack against the user, causing that attack to automatically miss. If the user has the Telepathy Capability, the user automatically succeeds on a mind- reading attempt against the target, and may listen to the target’s surface thoughts as long as they remain Read. Mind Reader automatically misses against targets with the Mindlock Capability.

movelist.name: Calm Mind
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Special Attack 1 Combat Stage and raise the user’s Special Defense 1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Pure Power
abilities.effect: The Pokémon’s base attack stat is doubled. This may double any bonuses from Nature or Vitamins, but not bonuses from Features. Ability List: Q–U

abilities.name: Scrappy
abilities.effect: Ghost Types are not immune to the user’s Normal and Fighting-Type Moves.

abilities.name: Aura Storm
abilities.effect: For each injury the user has, they gain a +3 Bonus to Damage Rolls.
